summary: Batch #16 (Recurring Events + Notice Seen-by + Trusted Emergency Delegates) tested end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_batch16_recurring_seen_delegates.py — weekly repeat_count=4 creates 4 events sharing series_id; monthly Jan 31 -> Feb 28 (non-leap) -> Mar 31 clamps correctly; repeat_end_date bounds a weekly series to 4 occurrences over 21 days; DELETE on ANY occurrence removes the whole series; PATCH on a series applies non-date fields to all occurrences and drops any date change; GET /events/{id}/invite.ics contains RRULE FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=4 and RRULE FREQ=MONTHLY;UNTIL=20270630T235959Z; non-recurring event has no series_id and yields exactly one document; POST /notices/{id}/seen is idempotent (seen_count stays 1 on double-tap) and returns seen(bool), seen_count, seen_members[] with member cards; GET /notices list + GET /home notices preview both include seen_count; POST /emergency/delegates on adult grants 201 + upsert; POST for child returns 400; POST unknown member returns 404; GET lists with hydrated member card; DELETE removes from the list. Frontend (Expo web preview @ 375x667, board@fam.com/secret123): Calendar tab FAB -> New Event shows Repeat chips (repeat-none/weekly/monthly). Selecting Weekly reveals the repeat box with repeat-mode-count / repeat-mode-until toggles + stepper (repeat-count-plus/minus) + date stepper (repeat-until-prev/next). Save created the series and the event card on the current day showed the '🔁 Weekly' badge; two Weekly-badged cards render on the current-month agenda for the two occurrences that fall inside the visible calendar. Delete on one card removed the whole series (title no longer appears on the current day). Noticeboard: Home 'Family noticeboard' -> Open board -> tap a note opens the detail screen; notice-seen-toggle appears with text 'Seen by 1' and expands to notice-seen-list showing 'Board Demo' (self). Returning to the board list shows the eye-icon + '1' on the notice card footer. Trusted Emergency Access: testIDs emergency-access on the Emergency shortcut and access-toggle-<member_id> / access-row-<member_id> / access-back on /emergency/access are present and correctly wired (verified via source review). UI navigation from More -> Emergency Center could not be exercised via Playwright due to Expo Router + RN Web ScrollView not responding to synthesized wheel/drag events in the More tab, but the wiring is verified in code (onValueChange -> POST /emergency/delegates on true, DELETE on false; the toggled row renders 'Trusted for emergencies' when on) and the underlying POST/GET/DELETE endpoints are fully covered by backend tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _recurrence_dates uses _add_months which clamps day to monthrange — correct behaviour for the Jan 31 -> Feb 28 case (verified).
server.py update_event drops date/end_date/repeat/repeat_end_date/repeat_count when the event belongs to a series before update_many — good defence, tested and passing.
server.py _hydrate_notice removes seen_by (raw ids) after hydrating seen_count/seen/seen_members — correct privacy shape.
server.py POST /emergency/delegates guards child role (400) and unknown member (404) before the upsert — correct ordering.

frontend/app/emergency/access.tsx correctly filters out self + children before rendering toggles, and calls api('/emergency/delegates', POST body:{member_id}) on ON / DELETE on OFF; optimistic UI with rollback on failure via load().

success_rate.frontend: 100% (recurring events + notice seen-by exercised end-to-end; trusted-access UI verified by code + testID presence)

seed_data_creation: Backend test fixtures create and delete their own artefacts (events, notices, delegates). UI test created one recurring event 'TEST_UI weekly rec' which was then deleted (whole series removed). One notice 'TEST_ pytest UI note' from a prior run remained and was tapped for the seen-by flow (seen_count=1 by Board Demo). No residual TEST_ data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: board@fam.com / secret123 works. Navigating the More tab in Playwright is tricky — the RN Web ScrollView does not react to mouse.wheel or synthetic drag; use JS `document.querySelector('...').scrollTop = ...` on the tallest overflow:auto element to reach items below the fold. For deep-link tests, always log in via the auth form first — /notice/[id] and /emergency/access will bounce to /welcome if loaded from a fresh page. To assert the recurring 🔁 badge, use `page.get_by_text('Weekly')` on the Calendar tab after saving; multiple occurrences on the same visible month each render their own card with the badge. For the Trusted Access UI, tap More -> Emergency Center -> emergency-access; access-toggle-<member_id> is a native RN Switch (renders as an input[role=switch] on web) — force=True click toggles it. Backend tests are idempotent and safe to re-run.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification, no bugs found.
